ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, in vacuum, in the same plane, on the straight line MN are fixed two point charges whose charge quantities are respectively -9Q and +Q, and the distance between them is L. Taking the +Q charge as the center of the circle, draw a circle with radius L/2. a, b, c, d are four points on the circumference, among which a and b are on the straight line MN, and the line connecting c and d passes through +Q and is perpendicular to the straight line MN. A negative test charge with charge quantity q moves on the circumference. Comparing the four points a, b, c, d, which of the following statements is correct? (  )
A. The electric field strength at point b is the greatest
B. The electric potentials at c and d are equal
C. The electric potential energy of charge q at point b is the greatest
D. The electric potential energy of charge q at point d is the greatest
